---
name: Feature Intake
about: Submit a new feature for evaluation and prioritization
title: "[FEATURE INTAKE]"
labels: feature-intake
assignees: ''
---

**Business Context**  
Describe the business need or problem this feature will address.

**User Story**  
As a [type of user], I want [what] so that [why].

**Success Metrics**  
How will we measure if this feature is successful? (e.g. KPIs, adoption targets)

**Priority**  
- [ ] High  
- [ ] Medium  
- [ ] Low  

**Stakeholders**  
Who requested this and who will be impacted?

**Dependencies / Blockers**  
List any teams, tools, or work that must happen first.

**Additional Information**  
Attach mockups, designs, links to spec docs, wireframes, etc.
